I went through all three. Version 1 is the one for me.

Version 1 keeps each card compact — the long description and my note both trimmed down to a couple of lines — so I can run my eye down a big collection quickly, but the moment I want the whole thing, **Show more** opens it right there in place, and **Show less** tucks it back. That's the balance I want: tidy for scanning, full access one tap away, and I never leave the list to get it.

Version 3, showing everything all the time, would turn a long collection into an endless scroll — one wordy bookmark could take up half the screen, and I'd lose the "glance and find" feeling entirely. Version 2 looks neat with the fade, but the only way to read the rest of my own note is to go into editing, and that's too much friction — my note is something I wrote to remind myself, I should be able to just read all of it without pretending I'm going to change it.

So Version 1. Compact by default, expandable in place, and — importantly — nothing is ever hidden for good; the complete description and note are always reachable right from the card.
